entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker who has seen planes leveled and all life rendered to dust.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker connected to the land, who speaks of angry baloths.

entities.name: Rampaging Baloths
entities.description: Zendikar beasts that are angry when the land is angry.

entities.name: The Roil
entities.description: The upheaval of Zendikar, to which earthquakes, boulders and dust storms are sometimes wrongly attributed.

entities.name: Terra Stomper
entities.description: A huge Zendikar creature whose effects are sometimes confused with the Roil.

events.summary: Sorin Markov says he has seen planes leveled and life reduced to dust, which brought no pleasure even to his dark heart.
events.quote: I have seen planes leveled and all life rendered to dust.

events.summary: Nissa Revane says the baloths are angry when the land is angry.
events.quote: When the land is angry, so are they.
